verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a bulk operation is IAM's CSV-based user import, which handles many items at once but only for one resource type. The CLI, SDKs, REST API and Terraform provider are general automation building blocks, and nothing documents bulk commands in them. missing for 10: documented general-purpose bulk/batch operations across resource types (e.g., bulk delete/update/tag in Console or CLI), bulk actions beyond user import, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Import users using a comma-separated values (CSV) file.
